summary: [para 12] 12. The Commission vide its order dated 18.7.2022 in Petition No. 472/TT/2020 allowed the capital cost as on 31.3.2019 with respect to the Combined Asset and Additional Capital Expenditure (ACE) for the 2019-24 tariff period. The details are as follows: [para 13] 13. The Petitioner in the instant true-up Petition has claimed capital cost as on 31.3.2019 with respect to the Combined Asset and actual ACE incurred vide the Auditor Certificate dated 20.9.2024 for the 2019-24 tariff period as under: [para 14] 14. We have considered the submissions of the Petitioner. The total Capital Cost **₹** 173694.12 as on 31.3.2019 was approved by the Commission in respect of transmission Asset-A to Asset-K vide order dated 18.7.2022 in Petition No. 472/TT/2020 and thus, the same is being considered as Opening Capital Cost in respect of Combined Asset for truing up of transmission Tariff for 2019-24 Tariff Period. [para 28] 28. Accordingly, the capital cost and trued-up ACE approved in respect of the Combined Asset for 2019-24 tariff period is as follows: [¶] Commission in instant order and thus, the same is being considered as the opening capital cost as on 1.4.2024 for determination of Annual Fixed Charges in respect to Combined Asset for the 2024- 29 tariff period in accordance with Regulation 19(3)(a) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. [para 73] 73. The Annual Fixed Charges allowed with respect to the Combined Asset for the 2024-29 tariff period are as follows: [¶] the Petitioner’s submissions, the Petitioner is allowed to file a single consolidated Petition comprising security expenses, capital spares individually costing more than ₹10 lakh and insurance expenses on an estimated basis as per the 2024 Tariff Regulations for the 2024-29 tariff period. [para 88] 88. We have considered the Petitioner’s submissions. The billing, collection, and disbursement of the transmission charges for the Combined Asset shall be recovered in terms of provisions of the 2020 Sharing Regulations as provided in Regulation 57 of the 2019 Tariff Regulations for the 2019-24 tariff period and Regulation 78 of the 2024 Tariff Regulations for the 2024-29 tariff period.
